Valid draft status: human_review_ready | attempts: 1
Unverified draft status: halted_retry_cap_reached | attempts: 3 | last error: attempt 3: missing verbatim ['NM_007294.4:c.5266dup', 'Pathogenic', 'reviewed by expert panel']
Why this pattern prevents silent failure: When the drafter paraphrases Pathogenic into likely pathogenic or drops the versioned transcript NM_007294.4:c.5266dup, the invariant gate blocks progression, logs every failed attempt, stops after 2 retries (3 total attempts), and forwards the untouched ClinVar JSON record for human review rather than emitting distorted clinical text.

Limits and references

Passing a schema and verbatim-token gate confirms provenance traceability, not clinical actionability: germline ACMG/AMP classification (Richards et al., 2015) differs from somatic oncogenicity/tiering (Horak et al., 2022), and database entries can lag behind newly published functional assays.

patches.before:
python3 inspect_counts.py counts.tsv

Before running it, predict the orientation and sample totals. The first column is gene identifiers, rows are genes and columns are samples. The checker requires a rectangular table with unique identifiers and finite, nonnegative integers, then sums each sample column. The expected column sums are sample_A: 16 and sample_B: 12; the arithmetic total is 28.

Answer rubric: identify genes as rows and samples as columns; report 16 and 12 by summing columns; reject negative values, decimals, NaN, and infinity as not nonnegative integer counts; and state that shape, integer, and sum checks do not prove that values are truly raw counts, have correct provenance, preserve sample identity, represent independent samples, or support any biological conclusion. The example is synthetic arithmetic only. Do not infer biology from it.

Python tool boundary: the optional Python checker uses only the Python standard library. This offline exercise never calls Cursor, Aider, or a hosted model, so it costs nothing to run; hosted model use in the live comparison above is optional and may incur charges.

Auditing AI edits on real bioinformatics code: Cursor rules, Aider test gates, and rejected diffs

In day-to-day bioinformatics, you use Cursor or Aider to extend scripts such as inspect_counts.R rather than editing prose. The two tools enforce boundaries differently:

The checker requires a rectangular table with unique identifiers and finite, nonnegative integers, then sums each sample column. The expected column sums are sample_A: 16 and sample_B: 12; the arithmetic total is 28.

Deliberately faulty proposal: “Each row is a sample, so the sample totals are 20, 3, and 5.” Reject it. Those are row sums for genes because the table is genes by samples, not per-sample totals. The correct response is to report the column sums above and explain the orientation.

chr17	7674220	.	C	T	1420.4	PASS	DP=82;AF=0.5	GT:AD:DP:GQ	0/1:44,38:82:99

Here 0/1 is an unphased heterozygous genotype (0|1 when phased), AD = 44,38 records 44 reference (C) reads and 38 alternate (T) reads (VAF = 38 / 82 = 0.463), DP = 82 is sample filtered read depth, and GQ = 99 is genotype Phred confidence.

Coordinate trap: 0-based half-open BED vs 1-based closed VCF and GTF

Off-by-one errors happen whenever BED intervals are mixed carelessly with VCF or GTF coordinates. For the single nucleotide at chr17 position 7,674,220 (TP53 coding SNV):

  • 1-based closed (VCF, GTF/GFF3, SAM POS, IGV locus box): start = 7674220, end = 7674220 (length = end - start + 1 = 1).
  • 0-based half-open (BED, BAM binary pos, Python slicing): chromStart = 7674219, chromEnd = 7674220 (length = chromEnd - chromStart = 1). Convert with bedtools or bcftools -R targets.bed (which already knows .bed is 0-based!) rather than subtracting 1 ad hoc in spreadsheets.

  • What the P69905 monomer entry omits biologically: functional human adult hemoglobin is an α2β2 heterotetramer (two HBA1/HBA2 α-globin chains paired with two HBB β-globin chains), and each globin pocket coordinates an iron-porphyrin heme b cofactor via the proximal histidine (His88 in 142-aa UniProt P69905 numbering; His87 in mature cleaved numbering). AlphaFold DB's AF-P69905-F1 entry folds the 7-helix globin core with high pLDDT because evolutionary couplings preserve the pocket geometry, yet the coordinate file contains zero heme atoms, zero O2, and no α/β subunit interfaces. Likewise, in cancer structural genomics, AlphaFold backbone coordinates are insensitive to single destabilizing missense mutations (ΔΔG; Pak et al., 2023): do not conclude a somatic missense variant is benign because a predicted monomer backbone still shows pLDDT > 85.

Symptom: Output CSV is missing records or header only.

patches.before:
⚠️ Pitfalls to Avoid

The explicitly selected start cluster sets orientation; it does not validate that a lineage exists. Replace the placeholder only after stating why that cluster is a plausible start, confirm it is present, and compare defensible alternatives. PCA distances and UMAP distances are not interchangeable, so inspect fitted curves in their fitted PCA representation if curve geometry is needed.

Exploring expression along inferred lineages

The tradeSeq package fits negative-binomial generalized additive models to count data using pseudotime and lineage weights. Its tests identify expression patterns associated with the fitted ordering; they do not establish causal driver genes.

The inputs must be aligned by cell: rows of the count matrix are genes and columns are cells; pseudotime and cell-weight matrices have cells by lineages. Select the knot count with the package guidance, inspect per-gene convergence, and account for multiple testing when interpreting results. associationTest tests association with pseudotime; startVsEndTest compares fitted expression at lineage endpoints.

R (primary): Monocle3 principal graph and root

Monocle3 uses its own cell_data_set representation and learns a principal graph directly on the low-dimensional UMAP embedding by default (learn_graph(cds) uses reduction_method = "UMAP"; Cao et al., 2019). Because 2D UMAP layouts can compress or tear global manifold distances, inspect whether apparent branches or bridges persist across reasonable UMAP neighbor settings and independent PAGA/PCA checks before interpreting them biologically. Conversion from Seurat requires SeuratWrappers::as.cell_data_set() (installed from GitHub), and root selection must be supplied explicitly from known early-state cells.
